-- =============================================================================
-- 0030_content_pages.sql - Phase 13 content & SEO layer.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Editable marketing pages (About, How It Works, Safety, FAQ) plus the
-- foundation for blog/articles. Body is authored in markdown so non-developers
-- can edit copy; the frontend renders through a small safe markdown subset.
-- =============================================================================

BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS content_pages (
  id                    UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  -- URL slug like 'about', 'how-it-works', 'safety', 'faq'. Lowercase
  -- letters, digits, and hyphens only.
  slug                  TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  title                 TEXT NOT NULL,
  -- Body in markdown so admins can author without HTML knowledge. The
  -- frontend renders this via a safe markdown subset.
  body_markdown         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  -- SEO metadata.
  meta_description      TEXT,
  meta_og_image_url     TEXT,
  -- Publish gate. Drafts are admin-only; published pages are public.
  is_published          BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  published_at          TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at            TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at            TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT content_pages_slug_format CHECK (slug ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$')
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_content_pages_published
  ON content_pages (is_published, slug);

CREATE TRIGGER trg_content_pages_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON content_pages
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

-- Seed the four MVP marketing pages as drafts. Admin publishes them
-- after copy review.
INSERT INTO content_pages (slug, title, body_markdown, meta_description)
VALUES
  ('about',
   'About PepNationRX',
   E'## About PepNationRX\n\nPepNationRX connects patients with independent, licensed healthcare providers for convenient, affordable telehealth services.',
   'PepNationRX connects patients with independent licensed providers for telehealth visits, lab orders, urgent care, and ongoing prescription management.'),
  ('how-it-works',
   'How PepNationRX Works',
   E'## How It Works\n\n1. Sign in and complete a clinical intake.\n2. A licensed provider reviews your responses.\n3. We coordinate prescriptions, labs, and follow-up visits.',
   'Learn how PepNationRX handles intake, clinician review, prescriptions, lab ordering, and follow-up care.'),
  ('safety',
   'Safety And Compliance',
   E'## Safety And Compliance\n\nWe operate under a HIPAA-compliant infrastructure and only work with board-certified providers licensed in your state.',
   'PepNationRX operates under HIPAA-aligned controls with board-certified providers, audited prescription review, and PHI encryption at rest.'),
  ('faq',
   'Frequently Asked Questions',
   E'## Frequently Asked Questions\n\n**Q: Who reviews my intake?**\n\nA: A board-certified provider licensed in your state.',
   'Common questions about PepNationRX visits, labs, urgent care, prescriptions, and billing.')
ON CONFLICT (slug) DO NOTHING;

COMMIT;
